title: Malformed statistics escape telemetry isolation and unmount the camera pipeline

trigger: In the actual VisionCanvas camera/engine bridge, preserve the genuine PipelineMetrics.snapshot() object except replace stages with null at the 250ms publication. This is explicit synthetic fault injection, not a naturally observed collector output.
expected: Treat the invalid statistics as unavailable or contain a details-render failure; retain the video, scheduler, SDK and their existing lifecycle.

cause: telemetry catches computation exceptions only. A non-null malformed result reaches setPipelineStats, then unguarded stages indexing during child React rendering, outside telemetry and without a details-only error boundary.
limits: No spontaneous path from valid PipelineMetrics events to stages=null was found. Ordinary and throwing-clock/observer/computation paths pass. Finding concerns the explicitly requested invalid-statistics fault tolerance, not a claimed normal-use crash.
authorAction: Contain malformed statistics/render failures within the details telemetry feature, retain the existing pipeline, add a regression preserving a live camera/SDK/ownership, publish a new frozen HEAD/tree and validation, return to the same independent reviewer.
